visual_action: A montage of clips featuring Joe Biden and Kamala Harris. It begins with Biden smiling while speaking at a podium. This is followed by a shot of Biden posing with factory workers, Biden and Harris on a campaign stage, and the two of them walking together in the White House. The video then cuts to various B-roll shots of Wilmington and Delaware, including an aerial view of the city, a "Welcome to Delaware" highway sign, the "Charcoal PIT" restaurant, a throwback photo of Joe and Jill Biden, and scenic shots of a river and a bridge at sunset.

cast.name: Joe Biden
cast.evidence: Appears in multiple clips throughout the video, is the sole speaker, and is mentioned on the "Welcome to Delaware" sign.

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: Appears alongside Joe Biden on stage and walking in the White House, and is mentioned in the on-screen text "Team Biden-Harris".

cast.name: Jill Biden
cast.evidence: Appears in an older, still photograph with Joe Biden.

cast.name: John Carney
cast.evidence: His name appears on the "Welcome to Delaware" sign, identifying him as the Governor.

on_screen_text.text: Team Biden-Harris headquarters will be in Wilmington
Don't tell me things can't change.
A place of hope and light
Home of President Joseph R. Biden, Jr.

spoken_summary: Joe Biden delivers an optimistic speech, saying, "Don't tell me things can't change. They can. And they do. That's America. That's Delaware. A place of hope and light and limitless possibilities."
audio_music: An uplifting and well-known instrumental track, identified as "Clocks" by Coldplay, plays throughout the entire video, creating a hopeful and inspiring mood.
editing_pacing: The video is a montage composed of several short clips that flow together at a steady, uplifting pace.
cultural_references: The song 'Clocks' by the band Coldplay is used as the background music.
central_claim: The Biden-Harris campaign headquarters will be located in Wilmington, Delaware, a place that symbolizes American hope, possibility, and Joe Biden's roots.
intended_effect: To generate positive feelings and a sense of inspiration about the Biden-Harris campaign by associating it with themes of hope, progress, and Biden's home state of Delaware.
